families.sameObjectReason: All tiers show the same open two-page volume; the smaller tier merely suppresses most page detail.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: The pale map panels retain their dark folded outline on every background; no major background-dependent change in reading occurred.

families.sameObjectReason: Each tier preserves a single folded-corner sheet with several horizontal writing marks.

families.sameObjectReason: The brown hair mass, face, and glasses resolve progressively while maintaining the same frontal head silhouette.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: The layered edges remain visible on all sheets, though the white front panel blends most with the white backing.

families.sameObjectReason: A portrait-and-text card persists at every size, with a top clip becoming obvious at larger sizes.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: The pale card retains a dark border on all backgrounds; its top clip has weaker separation on the gray field.

families.sameObjectReason: The same single window frame, colored top bar, and content panel scale consistently across tiers.

families.backgroundAmbiguity: The dark outer frame is stable across backgrounds; the pale content area blends slightly into the white backing.

families.sameObjectReason: The rectangular envelope and triangular flap lines persist; the corner badge is omitted or unresolved at 16px.

families.sameObjectReason: The same letter protrudes from a V-shaped open envelope at all three sizes.

families.sameObjectReason: Each tier retains the open-page silhouette and the orange object aligned with the center fold.
